text:
meredith-partners: Quick alignment on Marketplace 'slim-starter' IAC. Partner asked for a clear module contract + SBOM + signed artifact. Request: a single repo with modules/ + examples/ + packaging/manifests. Can we agree on exact module outputs and the packaging checklist?

noah-eng: Agree on repo shape. Modules: network, cluster, inference, kms. Examples: examples/aws, examples/gcp. Packaging: generate SBOM for modules, create signed zip, manifest.yaml with module list + checksums.

aoife-arch: Module contract ideas: keep modules provider-agnostic (no provider {}), inputs should be explicit and namespaced (eg: cluster_name, network_cidr, routing_mode). Required outputs for each module: network -> network_id, subnets; cluster -> cluster_endpoint, kubeconfig_raw, node_pools; inference -> routing_url, svc_account_email, ingress_acl_ids. We should also document a minimal IAM policy per cloud.

devin-terraform: I'll draft the modules with variables.tf, outputs.tf, README.md. For the top-level example include a small main.tf that wires modules and shows how to toggle autoscaler and routing_mode. I'll add an examples/manifest that lists which example maps to which cloud. Also: no provider blocks in module code and prefer explicit providers in examples.

meredith-partners: Partner wants acceptance criteria for marketplace review. My proposal: 1) terratest smoke deploy pass, 2) tfsec scan pass with no HIGH findings, 3) SBOM generated and attached, 4) artifact signed with our KMS key, 5) docs/arch.md with diagram + security checklist.

aoife-arch: Add to that: include a small cost-estimate section in docs/runbook.md for the demo footprint and a rollback section (terraform destroy caveats). Also a short section on HSM fallback: enable_hsm boolean and documented fallback to cloud KMS if HSM not present.

devin-terraform: For packaging pipeline I'll implement steps: tffmt/tflint, tfsec, terratest (small sandbox), sbom (cyclonedx), sign artifact (kms-sign), publish manifest. I'll include a sample manifest snippet in packaging/manifest.yaml with fields: name, version, modules (list), artifacts (path + checksum).

sbom-bot: SBOM check template created: https://ci.internal/redwood/sbom-templates. Use cyclonedx v1.4 and include sha256 checksums for artifacts.

noah-eng: Small but important convention: standardize output names across modules so examples can reference them reliably (eg: module.cluster.cluster_endpoint always exists). Also include a module VERSION file with semver and a CHANGELOG.md at repo root.

meredith-partners: Timeline: devin to open scaffolding PR by EOD Wed with basic packaging pipeline stub, aoife to drop arch diagram + IAM snippets by Thu, noah to add output-naming lint to repo template. We'll do partner walkthrough next Mon.

devin-terraform: Will do. Quick example snippet I'll include in PR:

```
module "network" {
  source = "../modules/network"
  network_name = "mpx-net"
  cidr = "10.10.0.0/16"
}
module "cluster" {
  source = "../modules/cluster"
  network_id = module.network.network_id
  cluster_name = "mpx-demo"
  node_pools = var.node_pools
}
module "inference" {
  source = "../modules/inference"
  cluster_name = module.cluster.cluster_name
  routing_mode = var.routing_mode # hosted | dedicated
  enable_hsm = var.enable_hsm
}
```

meredith-partners: Perfect. One extra ask from partner: include a tiny 'disable-autoscaler' example (show how to pin node pools). Add that to examples/aws/disable-autoscaler and examples/gcp/disable-autoscaler.

aoife-arch: I'll add a short troubleshooting cheat-sheet for marketplace reviewers: common TF failures, common IAM misconfigs, and how to validate SBOM signatures.

devin-terraform: Noted. I'll include a packaging acceptance test that validates SBOM matches artifact contents and that signature verifies with our public key.

meredith-partners: Thanks all. I'll send the partner an interim summary after scaffolding PR lands. :thumbsup:
